title: Other tribes are false
statement: Let $w,s$ be natural numbers, let $i$ be a coordinate among the $s w$ coordinates arranged in $s$ blocks of width $w$, and let $x$ be a sign assignment to those coordinates. The other tribes are false at $x$ if, for every block other than the block containing $i$, the AND of its coordinate signs equals $+1$.
